game.name: Midnight Club - Los Angeles - Complete Edition
game.desc:
Midnight Club: Los Angeles is a racing video game developed and published by Rockstar Games. The game features 43 cars and 4 motorcycles. The open world map of Los Angeles is size of all three cities from the previous installment combined.
The Complete Edition includes the main game and all the DLCs.
